verify_notes: Zig 0.14.1 must be on PATH. On this host it is installed at ~/.local/zig and symlinked at ~/.local/bin/zig. CI installs it from ziglang.org (tarball name order: zig-<arch>-linux-0.14.1.tar.xz).

GUI dev libraries are required to build (raylib links both Wayland and X11 via build.zig linux_display_backend = .Both): wayland-devel (provides wayland-scanner), wayland-protocols-devel, libxkbcommon-devel, libX11-devel, libXcursor-devel, libXrandr-devel, libXinerama-devel, libXi-devel, mesa-libGL-devel, mesa-libEGL-devel. Already installed on this host.

cmark-gfm is a git SUBMODULE at deps/cmark-gfm, not vendored source. A fresh worktree has it empty; install_commands runs 'git submodule update --init --recursive' (verified to work in linked worktrees). Without it the build fails with 'arena.c file_hash FileNotFound'.

Selkie is a native raylib GUI app, not a web UI, so browser verification does not apply. Visual verification is via headless PNG export: ./zig-out/bin/selkie --export-png out.png <file>.md (see CLAUDE.md CLI section).

Linking emits harmless LLD warnings ('archive member <lib>.so is neither ET_REL nor LLVM bitcode') for system shared libs; the build and 'zig build test' still exit 0. Do not treat those warnings as failures.
Version changes must update 4 files in sync: build.zig, build.zig.zon, data/selkie.1, data/io.github.aaddrick.selkie.metainfo.xml.
